Name: Simple Sprinkler Upgrade 2
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Sprinkler Plus One[/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=4]Features[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Works with Basic, Quality, and Iridium Sprinklers [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Pressure Nozzles still apply their normal bonus [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Does not change non-sprinkler machines [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Simple and lightweight [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.4+[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][center][b][size=4]Updated to Simple Sprinklers Upgrade 2[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Separate range settings for Basic, Quality, and Iridium Sprinklers.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Adjustable from +0 to +3, with +1 as the default.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Optional GMCM settings menu.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Toggleable placement coverage preview.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Pressure Nozzles retain their normal bonus.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Supports all 12 built-in languages.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][center][/center]
[center][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Install SMAPI. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][center][/center]
